title: Bigelow buys the ranch and starts NIDS monitoring
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Bigelow buys the ranch and starts NIDS monitoring, about 1996-2000s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And his story actually was brought to the attention of Robert Bigelow.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the current owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, told podcast host Jesse Michels how the ranch changed hands in the mid 1990s. He says the story of the family living there, the Shermans, reached Robert Bigelow, a wealthy businessman, who bought the ranch and set up the National Institute for Discovery Science, a private group that watched and studied the place. If true, it marks the start of serious, long running study of the ranch.
